contract.purpose: Find an existing dataset and report September actual KPI and spend.

tasks.prompt: Find an existing dataset and report September actual KPI and spend. Prerequisites: An owned dataset exists; the user declares units as KPI. No upload or pipeline refresh. Limits: Preserve dataset identity, declared roles, units and aggregation. Actual totals are not model attribution.

contract.purpose: Recover an oversized report by narrowing it, without changing the data.

tasks.prompt: Recover an oversized report by narrowing it, without changing the data. Prerequisites: Dataset 7 is known; declared roles are retained. Limits: Do not truncate results or upload, refresh or fit to repair a reporting refusal.

contract.purpose: Inspect campaign spend beside platform-attributed and channel-derived incremental evidence.

tasks.prompt: Inspect campaign spend beside platform-attributed and channel-derived incremental evidence. Prerequisites: Model and campaign-facts source exist; facts and attribution windows match. Limits: Platform conversions are attributed facts. Campaign incremental ROAS inherits channel assumptions and is not independently measured.

contract.purpose: Stop and hand off when campaign facts are unavailable.

tasks.prompt: Stop and hand off when campaign facts are unavailable. Prerequisites: A model is known; the app owns source registration. Limits: Missing facts are not zero conversions. Do not create or run a pipeline.

contract.purpose: Replace the explicitly authorised complete campaign map, then inspect the result.

tasks.prompt: Replace the explicitly authorised complete campaign map, then inspect the result. Prerequisites: The user approves all replacement rows and exact channel keys. Limits: Explicit user intent is required. PUT replaces the whole map; retain all authorised rows. A timeout leaves the write uncertain. Inspect facts, then hand off before another write.

contract.purpose: Inspect campaign facts after an uncertain mapping write; never replay automatically.

tasks.prompt: Inspect campaign facts after an uncertain mapping write; never replay automatically. Prerequisites: One replacement was authorised; its transport fails. Limits: Explicit user intent is required. PUT replaces the whole map; retain all authorised rows. A timeout leaves the write uncertain. Inspect facts, then hand off before another write.

contract.purpose: Inspect marginal evidence and calculate a bounded daily-equivalent campaign allocation.

tasks.prompt: Inspect marginal evidence and calculate a bounded daily-equivalent campaign allocation. Prerequisites: Completed model, matching currency, facts and curves; an explicit daily channel total is supplied. Limits: Read-only POST creates no run or platform change. Keep composite identity, provenance, constraints and unavailable uncertainty.

contract.purpose: Inspect fresh evidence after a stale campaign-budget basis refuses calculation.

tasks.prompt: Inspect fresh evidence after a stale campaign-budget basis refuses calculation. Prerequisites: The reviewed context key is supplied; facts change before calculation. Limits: Do not relax constraints, retry the POST or apply budgets automatically.

contract.purpose: Read experiment screening priorities and retain exclusions and uncertainty limits.

tasks.prompt: Read experiment screening priorities and retain exclusions and uncertainty limits. Prerequisites: A saved model has posterior marginal evidence and the backend supports test-priorities. Limits: Score is local binary perfect-information screening, not expected test benefit, design or recommended test budget.

contract.purpose: Stop experiment screening when the backend endpoint is unsupported.

tasks.prompt: Stop experiment screening when the backend endpoint is unsupported. Prerequisites: Saved model is known; no experiment creation is authorised. Limits: A missing route is an unavailable capability. Preserve refusal and hand off; do not fit or fabricate a score.

contract.purpose: Read response curves and decomposition in a visual or JSON-only client.

tasks.prompt: Read response curves and decomposition in a visual or JSON-only client. Prerequisites: Saved model is known. No capability/schema discovery is needed. Limits: JSON remains authoritative. Missing points stay gaps; Overlap is a separate reconciliation term in KPI units.

contract.purpose: Compare two exact saved optimiser allocations without creating a new run.

tasks.prompt: Compare two exact saved optimiser allocations without creating a new run. Prerequisites: Two owned saved run IDs are supplied for the same model. Limits: Decision Revenue/ROI and OptimizedEvalRevenue/ROI remain separate; read-only views create no allocation.

contract.purpose: Missing evidence stays unevaluated, review performs no write

tasks.prompt: Review saved Studies evidence without calling missing holdout evidence a pass. Prerequisites: Saved study and evaluations are known. Limits: not_evaluated stays not_evaluated. A read may produce an access audit event.

contract.purpose: Forward requested settings with exactly one creation

tasks.prompt: Create one explicitly authorised synthetic MMM and inspect status. Prerequisites: Dataset/schema prerequisites and user fit budget are supplied; fixture performs no real fit. Limits: Marketer/reviewer must stop and reconnect with full before authoring. Pending status is not acceptance.

contract.purpose: Read results then study evidence without writing

tasks.prompt: Exact model_hash model-example and run_id run-example. First check model status, then fetch only channel_summary results, then read study run evaluations with expanded reports. Do not write or infer missing evidence. Return exactly two JSON fields: roi from the sole channel, and holdout_status from the saved check.

contract.purpose: Discover inputs, submit once, poll the specific run and distinguish ROI conventions

tasks.prompt: Exact model_hash model-example. Check status, then get a two-period scenario template. After that submit one optimiser for the discovered channel: GBP1200, two periods, bounds 20 to 100 percent, laydown [1,2], period CPM [3,4], gamma 0.1, profit objective and forward margin 0.25. Other settings default. Poll the returned run_id until complete, never resubmit. Return exactly JSON fields run_id, decision_roi (ROI), fitted_roi (OptimizedEvalROI), objective_marginal (ObjectiveMarginal), posterior_mroi (MroiAtOptimized).

contract.purpose: Read a failed saved run without relaunching or inventing predictions

tasks.prompt: Recover the outcome of saved scenario scn-example on model_hash model-example. Read that exact run. Do not submit or retry a scenario. Return exactly status, error, and predicted_outcome (null when unavailable). A successful HTTP response does not mean the run succeeded.

contract.purpose: Cross-run review preserves incompatibility instead of ranking unlike outcomes

tasks.prompt: Compare run-a then run-b in study-example against policy-example. All prerequisites are complete. The comparison and its access audit are authorised; do not recommend, fit or promote. Return exactly comparable, blockers and preferred_run_id (null unless the evidence supports a ranking).

contract.purpose: Bind an authorised recommendation to the saved evaluation without claiming acceptance

tasks.prompt: For run-example in study-example, read saved evaluations with expanded reports. If the preserved assessment under policy-example passes, you are authorised to record one recommendation bound to that exact evaluation ID with reason 'Ready for analyst review'. Do not create another assessment or claim promotion. Return exactly decision_id, action, accepted.

contract.paraphrase: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. For Search, give me the combined January-February 2025 revenue and cost, and their return ratio. Use JSON fields channel, revenue, spend, roi and currency.

tasks.prompt: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. What was Search's total revenue, spend and ROI over January and February 2025? Return channel, revenue, spend, roi and currency as JSON.

contract.paraphrase: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. Show Search's marginal return at its current spending level, including its uncertainty bounds. Use JSON fields channel, median, lower, upper and hdi_prob.

tasks.prompt: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. What is Search's current marginal ROI and uncertainty? Return channel, median, lower, upper and hdi_prob as JSON.

contract.paraphrase: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. Are historical period-by-period marginal returns available in this saved fit? Use JSON fields available and reason.

tasks.prompt: The completed saved model is result-example. Revenue and spend are in GBP. Read existing evidence only. Can you report marginal ROI for each historical period? Return available and reason as JSON.

contract.purpose: Preserve explicitly supplied priors

tasks.prompt: You are authorised to create exactly one synthetic MMM using these explicit priors and settings. Capabilities and prerequisites are already checked. Do not fit or launch. Arguments: {"channels": [{"activity_column": "search_clicks", "name": "Search", "spend_column": "search_spend"}], "date_column": "week", "hierarchy_column": "brand", "kpi_column": "units", "priors": [{"channel": "Search", "mean": 0.2, "sd": 0.1}], "sampler": {"chains": 2, "n_samples": 100, "tune": 100}, "seasonality": true, "uploaded_file_id": 1}. Return the saved response as JSON.

contract.purpose: Inspect the saved VAR failure without restarting or fitting

tasks.prompt: Inspect the existing failed VAR model var-example. Read its saved failure reason. Do not retry, create, link, unlink or fit a model. Return JSON fields model_hash, model_type, status, failure_reason from the saved response.
